title: unique case Overlap with Multi-Bit Request
bug_signature: VCS-ERROR: unique case violation — multiple matching branches for req=4'b0011
expected_root_cause: The unique case construct on the multi-hot req vector requires mutually exclusive branches; when two request bits are simultaneously set both branches match, causing a simulation error and undefined synthesis behavior.
description: unique case on a multi-hot req vector triggers a simulation error when two request bits are simultaneously set, because unique case expects mutually exclusive values.
failure_log: VCS-ERROR: unique case violation — multiple matching branches for req=4'b0011
success_log: priority case selects exactly one branch for all multi-hot req values.
